Sustainability
Insurance is a long-term business, which is why we at ERGO always have our sights set on the future. We operate responsibly, are committed to environmental and climate protection, create a good working environment for our employees and are committed to others. Join us in looking ahead and find out what ERGO is doing for sustainability.

Strategy & Business, 27 June 2024
Megatrends shaping the maritime industry
Trend Talk with Edward Ler, Chief Underwriting Officer at ERGO Group AG
In his new format "Trend Talk", Edward Ler, Chief Underwriting Officer of ERGO Group AG, explains the current developments that are driving the insurance industry and how ERGO is dealing with them. In the first episode, he talks about the future of marine insurance against the backdrop of dynamic world trade. Find out more in the video.
